en.headline: Tsang Yee-ting takes Asian Games karate silver in -50kg kumite
en.dek: The Hong Kong fighter finished runner-up to Malaysia's Shahmalarani Chandran after a scoreless final decided by judges at Toyohashi Gymnasium on Wednesday.
body: Hong Kong karateka Tsang Yee-ting claimed silver in the women's kumite -50 kilogrammes at the Asian Games on Wednesday, adding a fifth karate medal for the SAR at the Aichi-Nagoya Games.

Competing in her fourth Asian Games and fresh from the Asian Championships title in June, Tsang met Malaysia's Shahmalarani Chandran in the final at Toyohashi Gymnasium. Neither fighter scored within the three-minute limit, and the judges awarded the bout to the Malaysian athlete.
Tsang had received a bye in the round of 16, then defeated Chung Ya-chi of Chinese Taipei 6-0 in the quarter-finals and Marie Adriano of the Philippines 5-4 in the semi-finals.
With the karate programme now complete, Hong Kong has collected five medals in the discipline: two silvers and three bronzes.

zh.headline: 曾綺婷亞運空手道女子組手50公斤級奪銀
zh.dek: 港隊選手周三於豐橋市綜合體育館決賽0比0不敵馬來西亞對手，以裁判判定屈居亞軍，為港隊本屆亞運空手道第五面獎牌。
body: 港隊空手道選手曾綺婷周三在亞運女子組手50公斤級決賽奪得銀牌，為香港在本屆愛知・名古屋亞運空手道項目添上第五面獎牌。
曾綺婷出戰第四屆亞運，並於今年6月剛奪得亞洲錦標賽冠軍。她在豐橋市綜合體育館決賽面對馬來西亞的Shahmalarani Chandran，雙方在三分鐘內均未能得分，最終由裁判判定馬來西亞選手勝出。
曾綺婷十六強輪空，其後在四分一決賽以6比0擊敗中華台北的鍾雅淇，半決賽以5比4險勝菲律賓的Marie Adriano。
空手道項目比賽完結後，港隊共取得五面獎牌，包括兩銀三銅。
